meta.sourceTitle: Table (7RSE)_all-India: RSE (in percent) of participation rate and RSE (in percent) of estimates of time (in minutes) spent in a day on an average per participant in SNA activities, Non-SNA activities and residual other activities where the activity was a major activity (considering only the major activity of the time slots) for each broad principal activity status at all-India level
meta.note: January–December 2024 survey, age 6 and above unless the source header names another universe. Snapshot axis is an annual anchor, not an observation on 1 January. Source dashes are catalogued as unavailable and never changed to zero. Source revision date beyond this report edition is not supplied.
